mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within 6 months of a positive GDP acceleration signal, leading to negative 60-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances following a sharp UNRATE increase signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly decreases, signals a weakening supply-side economy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following a sustained INDPRO decline signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following a strong HOUST increase signal.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 50,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 50k jobs/mo for 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances following a sustained PAYEMS growth slowdown signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales fall for 3 consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rising unemployment rate.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a sustained RSAFS decline signal, or if UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary surge that the market has not yet priced in, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
